title: IT Senior Business Analyst - Non Manager
description:
IT Senior Business Analyst - Non Manager


Reference number: JR260057

Location: London

Working pattern: Full Time, 37.5 Hours Per Week

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract, 31st December 2027

Number of roles: 1

Grade: IT5B

Salary: Up to £67,200 Per Annum


We are looking for a IT Senior Business Analyst to join our team.


Role Summary


This is a role managing customer demand/expectations. You will assist with the delivery of change by partnering with other IT functions and business units to understand their needs, working to ensure they receive optimum service from us and help coordinate prioritised delivery. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will:


  • Contribute to IT roadmaps and assist with business review and prioritisation.

  • Contribute to the definition of standards for Analysis and change practices and ensure these are adhered to.

  • Represent IT with senior stakeholders, leading the analysis of issue investigation, options, decisions, results, and communication.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who may be currently working as a Business Analyst or Project Manager, who is looking to expand their skills and build their career with an industry leader. 


A detailed job description can be viewed here. If the link does not work for you, please copy and paste the following URL into your web browser: https://22f9d6yr



What you’ll bring to the role


  • Experience in owning the delivery of multiple projects in a matrix systems environment.

  • Demonstrable Business Analyst experience with Software evaluation and software RFPs.

  • Comfortable in coordinating and facilitating the requirements workshops and negotiating with up to 10 stakeholders.

  • Skilled at uncovering true business needs, identifying solution options, and presenting proposals delivering business benefits. Confident at presenting ideas and recommendations.

  • Exceptional communication skills – both written and verbal translation of technology to business terms.

  • Target-driven and focused on owning a business solution delivery timeline.

  • A team player, able to work collaboratively with and through others.

  • Willing to travel to UK and Asia / South Africa offices if required.

  • Self-organising and customer / end-user delivery focused.

  • An understanding of data governance frameworks and protocols.

  • An understanding of ITIL processes and standards.


What we do


Kaplan Professional is a leading provider of apprenticeships, accountancy / tax / finance & banking courses, and professional assessments. For almost 80 years, we've helped shape the development and careers of finance professionals.


What we believe in


Our goal is for Kaplan to be a great place to work where everybody can succeed, so we truly live and breathe our values: act with integrity, grow knowledge, empower & support, create opportunity, drive results together.


Kaplan is a global organisation whose mission is rooted in providing equal access to education and opportunities for advancement to people of all backgrounds. We believe diversity, equity and inclusion - of culture, experiences, perspectives - are paramount to creating success and opportunity in an ever-changing world. As an educator, partner and employer, Kaplan is committed to promoting an equitable world in which diverse talent can develop, advance and thrive.

What we offer


As well as a competitive salary, transparent pay structures, hybrid/home working where possible, and paths for career progression, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:


• 28 days annual leave + option to purchase more

• Season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme

• Big discounts on Kaplan courses for you and your family

• Private medical, income protection, and life insurance

• 24/7 confidential helpline providing counselling and other support services

• Company pension contributions

• Maternity, Adoption, Shared Parental and Paternity/Partner pay which is well above statutory levels


How to apply


To apply for this role please submit a CV along with a Cover Letter detailing how you meet the requirements of the role no later than 11pm on Friday 4th December 2026. Note, we recommend that you apply at the earliest as we reserve the right to close the role before the closing date if we have gathered a suitable shortlist.



Application Support


If you require support completing your application or wish to talk to someone about the role before applying please email the Recruitment Team .


Disability Confident Scheme


As a Disability Confident employer, we are committed to interviewing applicants with disabilities who meet the minimum criteria for the role as per the job description and any screening or testing stages.  Details of how to request your application be considered under the Disability Confident scheme will be shared with all applicants upon submission of an application.
